assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is medically necessary to document the intermittent arrhythmias described in the clinical indication
The service supports the diagnosis of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and atrial fibrillation
